Before you enquire

A few useful answers.

Do you give a fixed construction price online?

Not initially. Area, design, soil and site conditions, specifications and scope all affect the final quote.

Can I buy only sand, bricks or cement?

Yes. Share the material, quantity, location and date so availability and delivery can be checked.

What if I am unsure about with-material or labour-only work?

Choose “Need advice” in the construction form. We can discuss which responsibility split suits you.

Are the project photos on this preview real client work?

No. They are clearly labelled illustrative demo images and should be replaced with your own approved project photos before public launch.
